statement: Let V be a minimal compact complex surface with b1(V ) = 1, κ(V ) = −∞, and b2(V ) > 0. (i) If V has a nonzero effective divisor C with C2 = 0, then V has a global spherical shell. (ii) If V has exactly b2(V ) rational curves, then V has a global spherical shell. Here the conclusion supplies an embedded open neighborhood of S3 ⊂ C2 \ {0} with connected complement in V .
